lines: Hum ke thehre ajnabi itni madaraton ke baad
couplets.en: After all that hospitality, we are strangers still.

lines: Phir banenge aashna kitni mulaqaton ke baad
couplets.en: How many meetings before we know each other again?

lines: Hum ke thehre ajnabi itni madaraton ke baad
couplets.en: After all that hospitality, we are strangers still.

lines: Kab nazar mein aayegi be-daagh sabze ki bahaar
couplets.en: When will we see the spring grass green and unmarked?

lines: Khoon ke dhabbe dhulenge kitni barsaaton ke baad
couplets.en: How many seasons of rain will wash the bloodstains away?

lines: Dil to chaha par shikast-e-dil ne mohlat hi na di
couplets.en: I wanted to speak, but heartbreak gave me no respite.

lines: Kuch gile shikwe bhi kar lete munajaaton ke baad
couplets.en: After our prayers, we might have spoken of what hurt.

lines: The bahut be-dard lamhe khatm-e-dard-e-ishq ke
couplets.en: The moments when love's ache ended were merciless.

lines: Thin bahut be-mehr subhein mehrbaan raaton ke baad
couplets.en: The mornings were cold after such tender nights.

lines: Ankahi hi reh gayi woh baat sab baaton ke baad
couplets.en: After all that talk, the one thing stayed unsaid.
